args.request: Could you make an ad for the bottle in this pic, keeping the bottle looking like mine? I’m a little worried it might end up looking like a different bottle once it’s turned into an ad. I’d like a clean studio look with a few moving close-ups, and the video should be 15 seconds long in vertical 9:16 format. For the words on screen, start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Please use mellow music with no talking.

story.title: Your everyday bottle
story.setting: A clean, bright white studio with a seamless light-grey backdrop, soft diffused studio lighting and gentle shadows, premium product-ad look.

subjects.words: A matte black insulated water bottle with a rounded cylindrical body, a black screw cap with a ribbed band and a small square carry loop on top, no logo.

beats.text: Opening title card, light grey background, dark text.
Medium close-up: the bottle stands on the studio floor while the camera slowly orbits around it.
Close-up: the camera slowly tilts up the matte black body to the ribbed cap and carry loop.
Close-up: slow push-in along the side of the bottle as soft light glides across the matte surface.
Closing card, light grey background, dark text.

story.music: mellow, calm lo-fi with soft piano and warm bass, no vocals

3. A 3-second close-up tilting up the matte black body to the ribbed cap and carry loop.
